mission: Determine whether the M3L rank-16 query-sketch shortfall is primarily a historical address-state capacity limit or a limitation of the Gaussian second-order sketch family, before any new continual-language formal experiment.

sampling.group_unit: ByteSequenceDataset sequence row; all tokens from one sequence remain in the same train or test split
sampling.ownership_semantics: identical to M3L temporal parent-lifetime ownership
sampling.old_domain_balancing: identical to M3L equal cap per old domain before concatenation

capacity_grid.rank_0_semantics: diagonal Gaussian moments only: count, mean, and per-dimension residual variance
capacity_grid.full_covariance_storage: count + mean + dense dxd float32 covariance; report implementation bytes explicitly

gate_family.low_rank_estimator: regularized pooled low-rank Gaussian LDA; rank 0 reduces to diagonal LDA
gate_family.operating_threshold: Gaussian historical-score threshold targeting 10 percent old false-positive rate

offline_oracle.purpose: same upper-bound comparator as M3L; never used to construct a Gaussian candidate

classification_rules.ORACLE_NOT_SEPARABLE: coverage is sufficient but the offline oracle fails the registered M3L separability rule under the same temporal ownership semantics
classification_rules.LOW_RANK_CAPACITY_SUFFICIENT: at least one low-rank Gaussian candidate in the frozen rank grid satisfies every candidate feasibility threshold; report the minimum passing rank
classification_rules.FULL_COVARIANCE_REQUIRED: no low-rank candidate through rank 128 passes, but dense full-covariance Gaussian LDA satisfies every candidate feasibility threshold
classification_rules.GAUSSIAN_FAMILY_LIMITED: oracle remains separable but neither any low-rank candidate nor dense full-covariance Gaussian LDA satisfies every candidate feasibility threshold

interpretation_boundary: M3L-1 is a checkpoint-only capacity/family diagnostic. A low-rank or full-covariance positive classification only selects the historical address-state representation for a future registered online continual-language experiment. It does not convert M3L, M3R, or M3 into positive continual-learning results.
